# LeakEvidence — coverage, references & acceptance register

**Specification audit · 25 October 2026**

This register maps the supplied material to the [architecture](LeakEvidence-Website-Architecture.md) and [product/validation specification](LeakEvidence-Product-and-Validation.md). “Specified” means included in planning; it does not mean implemented, tested or deployed.

## 2. Master-guide coverage and deliberate adaptations

| Guide requirement | How the plan handles it |
|---|---|
| Branding first | Identity, logo/favicons, semantic palette, type, icons and asset production gate precede high-fidelity implementation |
| Distinct identity across portfolio | Evidence Atlas direction; original water infrastructure and document system; no reused Permra identity |
| Complete multi-page company website | Full sitemap covers problem, solutions, portfolio, five products, platform, capabilities, evidence, pricing, forms, access, company, trust and resources |
| Every product on home and dedicated route | Five visible homepage panels, mega menu, product index, dedicated pages, pricing rows and form options |
| Product screenshots, use cases, about/contact and CTAs | Assigned routes, screen requirements and conversion journeys |
| Results/stats/testimonials coverage | Evaluation scorecard and evidence-status page preserve proof coverage. No testimonials were requested or supplied; use explicit research questions, not invented quotes |
| Pricing matching commercial model | Five supplied units and hypotheses retained; no invented subscription tiers or annual discount |
| Guided demo and self-serve demo | Separate `/request-demo` and clearly labeled isolated `/demo`, as the brief expressly calls for an interactive preview |
| Complete sign-in presentation | Branded access page, field validation/help and honest disconnected state; no fake authentication |
| Trust/integrations | Trust and data-readiness routes distinguish proposed inputs from live connectors; `/integrations` redirect avoids false integration catalogue |
| LinkedIn/Crunchbase footer marks | Accessible inactive state until actual profile URLs are verified; no account creation |
| Section-specific visual and animation | Homepage storyboard plus per-page hero/visual matrix and motion rules |
| Horizontal and vertical scrolling | One controlled horizontal evidence chapter; ordinary vertical flow, short sticky case sequence, static mobile/reduced-motion equivalents |
| Hover/focus/pressed/loading/error/success | Component-state specification and form/demo behavior |
| React, GSAP/ScrollTrigger, Lenis | Planned future stack with Lenis conditional on accessibility/device suitability; no code written in spec phase |
| Responsive, keyboard and reduced motion | Breakpoints, focus behavior, skip controls, chart tables and short-screen fallback |
| QA, build, GitHub/Vercel/domain | Future acceptance and release gates; not claimed complete in this planning deliverable |
| No default favicon/builder marks | Explicit production QA gate; original brand assets required |
| Claim accuracy | Research, supplied requirements, design proposals, synthetic records and unknowns kept distinct |

The brief's “one clear landing page” is expanded into a complete site under your explicit master-guide preference. Its content sequence and conversion logic remain in the homepage. Internal campaign operations, later Notion schema and revenue reasoning are retained as handoff specifications rather than published as misleading customer-facing proof.

## 4. Research sources and claim boundaries

Research used the configured Perplexity research tool's high preset. The following official sources support the narrow context below. Original brief citation numbers [13], [14], [15] did not include a bibliography; these direct sources replace unverifiable numeric references in the proposed website copy.

| Official source | Supports | Does not establish |
|---|---|---|
| [EPA — Water Audits and Water Loss Control for Public Water Systems](https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2015-04/documents/epa816f13002.pdf) | Real/apparent loss distinctions; NRW includes unbilled authorized consumption; audit, intervention and evaluation framing | LeakEvidence accuracy, regulatory approval, savings or local field performance |
| [FIDO — Leak Locate](https://fido.tech/products/leak-locate/) | Vendor-described acoustic sensing/analysis, localization and repair-validation offering; adjacent competition exists | Head-to-head performance or superiority of LeakEvidence |
| [Xylem Vue — water utility management](https://www.xylem.com/en-vn/brand/vue/platform/water-utility-management-software/) | Vendor-described modular water-loss and AMI-related applications | Integration compatibility, commercial partnership or validation of this concept |
| [Xylem — systematic NRW reduction](https://www.xylem.com/en-uk/making-waves/water-utilities-news/how-utilities-can-systemically-reduce-non-revenue-water/) | Meter/billing accuracy and physical loss are distinct parts of NRW work | Any quantified LeakEvidence improvement or accepted price |

Interpretation for this design: water accounting must distinguish measured inputs, estimates and classifications; an anomaly or residual is not automatically physical leakage. This is a proposed application of the source context to the interface, not an EPA-endorsed software specification.

### Typography sources

| Typeface | Official source/license | Implementation note |
|---|---|---|
| Newsreader | [Production Type repository](https://github.com/productiontype/Newsreader), [OFL](https://github.com/productiontype/Newsreader/blob/master/OFL.txt) | Preserve license and copyright notices with selected files |
| Manrope, Google Fonts release | [Google Fonts repository](https://github.com/googlefonts/manrope), [release OFL](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/manrope/OFL.txt) | Specify this release rather than assuming all Manrope downloads share its terms |
| Manrope V5 distinction | [Designer release and license](https://www.sharanda.com/manrope) | Different license; not the proposed release in this plan |
| IBM Plex Mono | [IBM repository](https://github.com/ibm/plex), [license](https://github.com/IBM/plex/blob/master/LICENSE.txt) | Preserve relevant notices and respect reserved naming restrictions |

## 5. Design and implementation acceptance gates

### Gate A — brand and content

- Original LeakEvidence logo, favicon and variants exist; no legal ownership claim inferred.
- Five module names and jobs appear on home, menu, index, dedicated page, pricing and intake.
- Every price preserves its supplied amount/unit and clearly says test hypothesis.
- Every public route has substantive, page-specific copy and visual content.
- No copied Permra artwork, UI, card sequence, claims or company details.
- No invented customers, partnerships, funding, certifications, headquarters or live integrations.
- LinkedIn/Crunchbase states reflect actual verified destinations.

### Gate B — product evidence

- All demo screens, charts, rows and exports carry DEMO/SYNTHETIC and concept status.
- Queue counts derive from the ten seed cases and match reports.
- Observed/recorded times, units, quality flags and source locators remain visible.
- The 20 October trend and 19 October reconciliation period are not silently conflated.
- Suspected/verified and workflow/evidence states remain separate.
- C01 stays suspected; C04/C09 historical confirmation is explicitly simulated.
- Missing values remain missing; alternative explanations and the failed recommendation are visible.
- Reviewer changes are local only; no dispatch, valve control, writeback or production connectors.
- Exports remain readable outside the demo and retain watermarks and provenance.

### Gate C — interaction and responsive QA

- Test 1440, 1024, 768, 390 and 320px widths plus short desktop heights.
- Test keyboard, touch, focus return, menus, form validation and every CTA destination.
- Test scroll down/up, direct anchors, reloads and route transitions.
- No blank critical text, stuck pins, offscreen focused controls or sideways page overflow.
- Reduced motion shows complete final content with normal vertical flow.
- All chart/map information has a readable summary/table alternative.
- Measure color contrast; do not rely on palette intent.
- Test image/font loading and low-power fallback; no layout-shifting media.
- Review required screenshots at 100% zoom with mobile-safe provenance labels.

### Gate D — commercial and operational honesty

- Unconnected forms say nothing was sent; connected forms report success only after verified delivery.
- No fake sign-in, SSO, reset email, booking, payment or CRM pipeline claim.
- Follow-up and marketing consent are separate and unchecked by default.
- No operational/customer data in public forms, demo or analytics.
- Actual privacy controller, processor, retention and deletion details are completed before real collection.
- Event instrumentation distinguishes view, click, local demo action, delivered enquiry and real booking.
- Pilot sponsor, operator, data owner and crew lead are tracked separately.
- Evaluation has comparator, representative negatives, visit budget, evaluator, window, threshold and cost.
- Go/no-go gates preserve procurement/legal/permission and human physical control.

### Gate E — later engineering and launch

- Production build, type checks and relevant behavior checks pass.
- All routes, assets, metadata, social preview, favicon and 404 are verified.
- No template marks, broken placeholders, secrets or personal filesystem paths in deployed code.
- Actual browser screenshots exist; generated artwork is not labeled as product implementation evidence.
- README explains local run/build, environment variables, integration boundaries and remaining gaps.
- GitHub, Vercel and custom domain are handled only in the later authorized build/release scope.
- Final review runs on the actual deployed URL; domain ownership and branding are separately verified.

## 6. Current handoff status

**Completed in this task:** reference/media study; official-source research; proposed brand direction; product inventory; complete IA; homepage copy/storyboard; all-page hero and content plans; motion/responsive rules; synthetic case and ten-record specification; data dictionary; sample evidence packet; pilot ask/scorecard; form/disclaimer/analytics/ad plans; screenshot brief; requirement coverage.

**Not performed or claimed:** logo/favicons drawn; high-fidelity design assets; product or website code; real demo captures; site accessibility/performance testing; lead collection; campaigns; account creation; Notion changes; production data access; legal or trademark review; name/domain purchase; GitHub push; deployment; customer/pilot validation.

**Inputs required for a future real launch, without blocking this specification:** verified company/domain ownership; approved logo assets; real profile/contact URLs; legal entity and privacy facts; configured form recipient/service; chosen repository/hosting/domain; approved licensed assets; production permissions if a later paid pilot proceeds. These are not needed to build the isolated synthetic prototype itself.
